description: Na₆Be₈O₁₁ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are three inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O²⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.46-2.86 Å. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O²⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.45 Å. In the third Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O²⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.89 Å. There are four inequivalent Be²⁺ sites. In the first Be²⁺ site, Be²⁺ is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O²⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Be-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.55 Å. In the second Be²⁺ site, Be²⁺ is bonded to four O²⁻ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing BeO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Be-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.67 Å. In the third Be²⁺ site, Be²⁺ is bonded to four O²⁻ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing BeO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Be-O bond distances ranging from 1.58-1.72 Å. In the fourth Be²⁺ site, Be²⁺ is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O²⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Be-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.58 Å. There are six inequivalent O²⁻ sites. In the first O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na¹⁺ and three Be²⁺ atoms. In the second O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Na¹⁺ and three Be²⁺ atoms. In the third O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four Na¹⁺ and two equivalent Be²⁺ atoms. In the fourth O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to four Na¹⁺ and two Be²⁺ atoms. In the fifth O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Na¹⁺ and three Be²⁺ atoms. In the sixth O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded to four Na¹⁺ and two Be²⁺ atoms to form distorted edge-sharing ONa₄Be₂ octahedra.
